# Estonia

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Estonian Banking Association (Pangaliit)

**Role:** Banking-association customer-bank standards publisher

**Reporting coverage:** Historical detailed common reporting standard; current implementation information directed to each bank

**Messages / versions:** camt.052.001.02; camt.053.001.02; camt.054.001.02

- [XML B2C/C2B notice and archived standards](https://pangaliit.ee/arveldused/xml-b2c-and-c2b-suhtlussonumid) — availability; public-page
- [Archived Account Reporting Standards for Bank to Customer v1.02](https://media.voog.com/0000/0042/1620/files/Account_Reporting_Standards_for_Bank_to_Customer_1_02-1.pdf) — specification; public-file

The official association page links its Voog-hosted PDF. Archived common reporting standard approved31Jan2013. Page says banks abandoned common payment-initiation standard from17Mar2024 and directs payment/reporting message information to bank websites; do not claim archived .02 applies unchanged to all banks today.
